title: RBI repo-rate effective-date event study
null: Mean three-session abnormal return (CAR) around supplied repo effective dates equals zero; paired alternative: event CAR differs between indices.
alternative: Mean CAR is nonzero or CAR distributions/sensitivity differ across index segments.
definition: Event CAR is sum of daily returns in [t-1,t,t+1] minus 3 times the mean daily return in estimation window [t-120,t-21].

Nifty Auto.method: Two-sided one-sample t-test of event CAR mean = 0; effective dates are proxy event dates
